scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with finite numerical checks; limits of numerical verification acknowledged. Scientific comparisons separate strongest prior general radial solution from additional geometric/occupation conclusions.
scientific_limitations: A theorem at only the two critical anisotropies; no classification of all nearby parameter regimes. Existing homogeneous-rigid inverse-radius linearization, general limit-cycle criteria, and critical polycycles are prior; new claims concern finite-time completeness versus unbounded forward motion, disk-truncated completeness area, and physical-time radial occupation. The algebraic reduction is not represented as new. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: A critical completeness basin and Pareto occupation in a cubic rigid flow
